reconcile.note: Henry reads the hardening texts as God judicially withdrawing grace already offered after persistent resistance, not a limit on his free giving in James and Luke.

sides.snippet: He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart
sides.verseText: \"He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, Lest they should see with their eyes, And perceive with their heart, And would turn, And I would heal them.\"

sides.snippet: who gives to all liberally and without reproach
sides.verseText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.
